title: Evaluation preserved by the DAG translation
statement: For every Boolean circuit $c$ on $n$ variables and every Boolean assignment $x$ to those variables, evaluating the directed acyclic graph translation of $c$ at $x$ gives the same value as evaluating $c$ at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a Boolean circuit on $n$ variables
$x$ is a Boolean assignment to the $n$ variables
